result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback 90-day software conformance warranty and includes workmanlike performance, no-malicious-code protection, and repair/re-performance/replacement/refund remedies. However, it omits the required compliance-with-laws warranty and does not provide the fallback 30-day warranty period for services. The software warranty trigger ('following the acceptance date and following delivery') is also ambiguous. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated commercial intent.
